items.name: Blue Super Dog
items.description: An animated black dog wearing a blue superhero suit, cape, and a yellow star emblem.
items.observation: Dog superhero character appearing throughout the video to help fix the car.

related_events.observation: Close-up pose of Blue Super Dog

items.description: A small yellow bear character wearing blue overalls.
items.observation: Small yellow bear character who needs help fixing his toy car.
